Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
So there's this new 3-discipline card only usable by Anarchs.

The animalism ability says:
+1 stealth action. Burn 2 life from an ally or retainer.

So, this isn't damage? You can use this ability against Ambrosius, for
example? That's pretty brutal.
